history.perspective: B14 - Tablet/iPad layout (supportsTablet: true - is it actually usable?)
history.outcome: functionally fine at tablet widths (live-tested 768x1024 and 1024x1366), but no content-width cap anywhere means forms like Zakat stretch full-bleed with awkward label/input gaps. Logged as a design-system-level recommendation (a maxContentWidth primitive in packages/ui), not fixed - cross-cutting visual design decision, out of scope for a single iteration.
